mechanism: Polyethylene glycol-based bowel preparation can cause fluid and electrolyte shifts that may worsen foscarnet-induced nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hyperphosphatemia).
action: Avoid PEG bowel preparation in patients on foscarnet therapy; if necessary, ensure aggressive hydration, close monitoring of renal function and electrolytes, and consider alternative bowel preparation methods.
